Listen to this article Share Kerrygold, the renowned Irish dairy brand from Ornua, strengthened its engagement with consumers at the 25th Women in Management, Business and Public Service (WIMBIZ) Annual Conference, held on November 5 and 6, 2026, at Eko Hotel & Suites, Lagos. The conference, which marked 25 years of WIMBIZ’s commitment to empowering women, brought together business leaders, entrepreneurs, professionals and public sector executives for conversations around leadership, enterprise development and the evolving role of women in business. This year’s edition was themed “Rooted, Rising, Ready: Born in Africa, Built for the World.” As a sponsor of the conference, Kerrygold leveraged the platform to increase brand visibility, deepen consumer engagement and strengthen its relevance among an audience of accomplished and influential women. A key feature of its participation was an exhibition stand where attendees had the opportunity to discover the brand, learn more about its product offerings and sample its products. The activation provided an opportunity for direct interaction with consumers, allowing guests to experience Kerrygold firsthand while creating meaningful brand touchpoints beyond traditional brand visibility. Through these engagements, Kerrygold reinforced its commitment to bringing its quality dairy products closer to consumers and building lasting relationships through relevant experiences. Commenting on the brand’s participation, Titilayo Ijiyokunola, General Manager, Ornua Dairy Products Nigeria Ltd. , said: “At Kerrygold, we recognise the important role women play in shaping businesses, industries and communities. Our participation at WIMBIZ provides an opportunity to connect with this community, recognise their contributions and support platforms that champion leadership, enterprise and professional growth.” Kerrygold’s participation at the conference reflects its continued interest in engaging consumers through platforms that bring people together, create opportunities for meaningful interactions and allow more people to experience the quality and distinctive offerings of the brand. About Kerrygold Kerrygold is a globally trusted Irish dairy brand renowned for its quality, rich taste and provenance. Built on generations of dairy knowledge and heritage, Kerrygold is made with the finest milk from grass-fed cows and quality ingredients, with no artificial ingredients. In Nigeria, Kerrygold Milk is manufactured and distributed by Ornua Nigeria, bringing the brand’s distinctive rich, creamy taste and heritage to consumers across the country.
